description: Navigate to the 'Family' activity in GCompris (often found in the Discovery or Humanities category, icon showing a family tree or group). Complete the first level by dragging the correct relationship labels (e.g., Grandfather, Mother, Brother) to the corresponding family members on the tree structure. Once the puzzle is solved and the success animation appears, take a screenshot of the completed state and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/family_tree_solved.png'.
